start_here: Say to your AI: "Open lesson grip of first-principles." It runs tool:read-a-lesson and shows the recording with its transcript.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the lessons, recording links and timed words of the pursuit database and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-a-lesson and the input.
3. Read the answer: the lesson with its recording, timed passages and the lessons around it. Show it with the screen the tool names.
